notes.title: Update 1.2.3 is available now!
notes.notes:
🚨 Patch Alert for All Chefs! 🚨

Attention, hard-working kitchen staff! 🍳👨‍🍳

We’ve just rolled out an exciting new update, packed with highly requested features to enhance your culinary journey. Let’s dive into what’s cooking!

[h2]New Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] 🪑🎉[b]Seating Experience Now Available![/b] 
No more standing on your feet all day! We’ve added accessibility options for seated play. Head to the settings menu, kick back, and cook up a storm while sitting comfortably. Your legs will thank you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44903873/a117055176bddff54ef79ec0a076d884f29f6475.png[/img]

[*] 🌠[b]Free Teleport Option: [/b]
Navigate your kitchen with ease using the new free teleport option! Just a heads-up: this feature isn’t available in the tutorial, so be sure to master the basics first!
[/list]

[h2]Updated Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] 🚀 [b]Overhauled First-Time User Experience: [/b]
New chefs can now jump into action faster and with clearer explanations. Get ready to sharpen your knives and skills quicker than ever!

[*] 🌟[b] Improved Bug Spray & Solar Flare VFX: [/b]
Spraying bugs and fending off solar flares has never looked this good. Enhanced visuals make your kitchen battles more dynamic and exciting.

[*] 🔔[b] Enhanced Lunch Rush Bell SFX: [/b]
The Lunch Rush is intense – and now the bell sounds even better, setting the perfect pace for the chaos ahead.

[*] 🍽️[b] Upgraded Customer Dish Review UI: [/b]
We've polished the dish review interface, making it clearer and more intuitive. Keep those customers happy and earn those five-star reviews!

[*] 🍕🍣 [b]Increased Visual Variety of Processed Ingredients: [/b]
Create dishes that are truly out of this world with even more visual variety in your processed ingredients. Your culinary creations have never looked this cosmic!

[*] 🛠️🐛 [b]Polished Various Items & Squashed Bugs: [/b]
We’ve been hard at work fixing and polishing elements throughout the game to ensure a smoother, more enjoyable experience.
[/list]

Thank you all for your continued support and passion for Astro Chef! We hope you enjoy these changes as much as we enjoyed creating them.

*** End of Alert ***

notes.title: Major update 1.2: Culinary Calamity is out now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44903873/7ddcaf0e639989a594400fe8e5b634f86f1c46f0.png[/img]



Hello, Galactic Chefs!

Get ready for a wild ride! Our most expansive update yet, Culinary Calamity, is now live. This major update brings a whole new level of chaos and excitement to your culinary adventures, all available at a special launch discount!


[h2]What’s New in Culinary Calamity?[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Lunch Rush Extremes:[/b] Prepare for the ultimate test during peak hours as alien customers demand faster service. Can you keep up when every second counts?
[*] [b]Total Kitchen Mayhem: [/b]Brace yourselves as space bugs invade, tools malfunction, and ingredients frequently go out of stock in an already frenzied kitchen environment.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44903873/84515aa2859ced0e2f66bddeed66a9c79d7da706.png[/img]

Watch the chaos unfold in our brand new trailer video right here! See the exciting new features and gameplay enhancements in action. 
[previewyoutube=6SOWUcvZ_OY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Enhanced Gameplay Experience:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Dynamic Gameplay Enhancements[/b]: The game now moves at a faster pace, thanks to the increased overall game speed and a completely reworked customer dish rating system that offers more responsive and dynamic feedback.
[*] [b]Revamped Tool and Ingredient Systems:[/b] We've refined how tools and ingredients are introduced and utilized, reducing complexity to enhance your focus on strategy and culinary skill.
[/list]

[h2]Innovations and Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Streamlined Single Player Tools:[/b] We've optimized the single-player mode to reduce redundancy without diluting the challenge, making solo play more enjoyable and less cumbersome.
[*] [b]Rebalanced Single Player & Co-op Progression:[/b] Enjoy a smoother and more engaging progression in both single-player and co-op modes, with adjusted difficulty curves and better-paced tool and ingredient unlocks to ensure a rewarding experience for all chefs.
[*] [b]Improved Scanning System:[/b] Say goodbye to repetitive scanning! With our new scanning tech, you'll have all the information you need displayed on newly installed kitchen monitors, freeing you to concentrate on cooking.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44903873/002770a101e306b20966f8ccc3a4c0805dbb83ca.png[/img]

[h2]Customer Interaction Overhaul:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Impatient Customers:[/b] With our latest update, customer animations have been enhanced to more clearly indicate their levels of satisfaction and impatience, adding a layer of urgency and realism to your service.
[/list]

[h2]New Features to Explore:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Revamped Co-op Mode: [/b]Team up and download the new Co-op Cookbook 1.2 from ([url=https://www.astrochef-game.com]https://www.astrochef-game.com[/url]) for tips on mastering these challenges with friends.
[*] [b]Enhanced Visuals and Audio: [/b]We've polished the visuals of plate icons and increased the audio tempo to match the new pace of the game, enhancing both the aesthetic and adrenaline of gameplay.
[/list]

[h2]Special Launch Promotion:[/h2]
For a limited time, enjoy a [b]30% discount[/b] on your journey into culinary chaos. It’s the perfect time to experience the heightened challenges and innovations that Culinary Calamity brings to the galaxy’s most unpredictable kitchens!

[h2]Get Cooking![/h2]
Whether you are a seasoned chef or a newcomer to our cosmic diner, Culinary Calamity offers fresh, fun challenges for everyone. Prep your stations and ready your reflexes for the culinary ride of your life.

Thank you for your passion and support. We are excited to see your culinary triumphs and challenges as you navigate through these new, exciting updates. Don’t forget to share your moments with us on social media!

Happy Cooking, Space Chefs!

notes.title: Major Update 1.2: Culinary Calamity Approaching!
notes.notes:
Hello, Space Chefs!

It's been a while since our last transmission. Behind the scenes, we've been grappling with a few glitches at our cosmic diner, but it seems the kitchen has spiraled into chaos more than we anticipated. Now, we need your culinary prowess more than ever!

Based on extensive feedback from our community on all platforms, we're thrilled to announce our most substantial update yet: Culinary Calamity! Brace yourselves for a whirlwind of kitchen mishaps and galactic oddities.

[h2]Here’s what’s on the menu for Culinary Calamity:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Total Kitchen Mayhem: Our diner has turned into a hotspot for chaos, where luck seems to have left the building. Prepare to tackle new challenges such as invasive space bugs, malfunctioning tools, and the dreaded 'Out of Stock' status for essential ingredients. As the galaxy’s top lunch destination, expect to serve a swarm of alien patrons. Just cross your fingers that the gravity generator holds up under the pressure!
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay Enhancements:[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Accelerated Pacing: [/b]Get ready to shift into overdrive with faster gameplay that'll keep you on your toes from start to finish.
[*] [b]Revamped Customer Dish Rating System:[/b] We've overhauled the dish rating system for better balance and progression, making every shift a step towards culinary mastery.
[*] [b]Rebalanced Progression in Single Player & Co-op:[/b]  We've fine-tuned shifts and events to ensure a smoother and more enjoyable journey through the cosmos. This includes a thoughtful introduction of new tools and ingredients, so new chefs feel welcome without being overwhelmed.
[/list]

[h2]Streamlined Experiences:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Simplified Single Player Tools:[/b] To enhance fun and maintain pace, we've streamlined tools, reducing complexity without sacrificing the spice of challenge.
[*][b]Enhanced Scanning Process:[/b] Constant scanning no longer cuts it. With upgraded kitchen tech, including new monitors, you’ll spend less time scanning and more time cooking.
[*] [b]Impatient Customers:[/b] Our customers now express their dwindling patience more vividly. Keep them happy before they decide to jet!
[/list]

[h2]Additional Enhancements:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Bug Squashing: General bug fixes to smooth out your gameplay.
[*] Uplifted Audio: We've cranked up the tempo for an even more thrilling kitchen adventure.
[*] Extra Spacecraft: Look out for new ships zipping around in space.
[*] Pico 4 Compatibility: We're excited to extend support to Pico 4 users.
[/list]

[h2]Release Date:[/h2]
Culinary Calamity will launch this month! Get ready to dodge disasters and deliver delectable dishes across the galaxy.

[h2]Looking Ahead:[/h2]
Post-update, we plan to enhance the party co-op experience further. Though it's a blast with buddies, we want even more chefs in the kitchen. So rally your friends and family for some party co-op fun!

We're eager for both new and veteran players to dive into these updates and experience the fresh challenges and fun that Culinary Calamity brings. Here's to more adventures in the galactic gourmet!

[b]Stay tuned, chefs, and prepare for a wild ride in the kitchen![/b]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.8 is available now!
notes.notes:
*** Hotfix Alert for Chefs! ***

Hello, Culinary Crew!

A keen observation from Chef AToxicKitten has brought to light a pesky bug that's been stirring up our menu. For those chefs who've set their stations to German and found themselves unable to select a chapter, we've cooked up a quick hotfix just for you.

But that's not all—we've also refined the First-Time User Experience (FTUE). The teleport panel now clearly indicates that the right thumbstick is your tool for magical culinary movement. No more confusion, just smooth teleportation to keep your kitchen adventures on track.

This swift update will iron out the wrinkles, ensuring all our German-speaking gastronomes—and every new chef in our ranks—can once again take charge of the kitchen with confidence.

Happy cooking, and may your dishes be flawless!

*** End of Alert ***

notes.title: The diner is open for business!
notes.notes:
[h1]Astro Chef is Out Now on SteamVR![/h1]

Astro Chef has landed on SteamVR, inviting you into a kitchen where a VR culinary adventure combines creativity with puzzle-solving. Master exotic dishes and restore a once-celebrated space diner to its interstellar glory!

[previewyoutube=p4i9LqVcb4o;full][/previewyoutube]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44903873/a715e7a5da8332af3e8ed7b300bcf227a1cbd279.png[/img]
[h2]EXPLORE & EXPERIMENT[/h2]
Who's got the scoop on alien taste buds? Spoiler: not you! Get experimental with ingredients, test out new recipes, and serve up some interstellar flavors to decode the gastronomic preferences of your extraterrestrial guests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44903873/59b8ccb0de0fd105b2918aed444eae8052ed0ba7.png[/img]
[h2]PUZZLE, LEARN & MASTER[/h2]
Navigating the kitchen is like mastering gadgets from another galaxy—some as straightforward as a space shuttle, others with quirks that defy gravity. Your task? Wrangle these cosmic tools to perfection, ensuring every alien ingredient is processed to out-of-this-world standards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44903873/29997bf8a7f3c7cdc45359467ccdcba58e3afb93.png[/img]
[h2]A JOURNEY TO INTERGALACTIC FAME[/h2]
Reviving your diner's fame means mastering 5 chapters to impress Intergalactic Lady Momona, starting without even basic dish know-how. Prepare for shifts full of surprises, as no two are ever the same!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44903873/7c6ad17cc15842a9ea08ffaa95732b20b5007550.png[/img]
[h2]PLAY IN SINGLE PLAYER OR WITH A FRIEND IN PARTY CO-OP MODE![/h2]
Solo play is a blast, but teaming up with a friend elevates the fun! In party co-op mode, one takes on the chef's role in VR, while the other consults the Kitchen Manual (available for free at www.astrochef-game.com) to decipher customer cravings and whip up winning dishes. A recipe for an unforgettable night!

[h2]HAPPY LAUNCH DAY![/h2]
We're thrilled for everyone to embark on the culinary adventure of Astro Chef and conquer the galaxy's most unique diner. To kick off the celebration, enjoy a 20% release discount until March 24th!

Loving your journey through Astro Chef? We'd be over the moon if you could [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1812230/reviews/]leave us a Steam review here[/url].

Happy cooking!
